description: Quark/gluon jet BDT vs Jet_qgl vs DeepJet QG, CMS Open Data simulation (RunIISummer20UL16NanoAODv9 QCD HT700-Inf). Not a CMS result.

selection.jets: all jets with 30 <= pT < 1000 GeV, |eta| < 2.5, tight ID (jetId & 2), genJetIdx >= 0
selection.working_points: thresholds set per bin on the test jets of that bin

scan.decision: no longer scan; final model = defaults (bdt0)

waivers.sculpting_raw_score: one global threshold on the raw score sculpts the gluon pT spectrum (runs/bdt0/sculpt/sculpting.json: PEARSON_R=0.3771, CHI2_NDF_0.1=609.88); the model is used only through the pT-DDT maps runs/bdt0/ddt/scores_ddt_<eff>.parquet.map.json, whose checks pass: eff 0.5: CHI2_NDF=1.33 P=0.11 PASS, eff 0.3: CHI2_NDF=1.0 P=0.466 PASS, eff 0.1: CHI2_NDF=1.56 P=0.0278 PASS
